glossary.definition: The policy can require explicit human approval before an agent action runs: the agent pauses, the human decides, and only a verified approval receipt lets the retried call through. The receipt is single-use and amount-bound.
At or above the MFA band the policy returns a STEP_UP obligation: the human must complete device MFA (demo OTP 123123) before the action runs. Step-up outranks the consent gate — highest gate wins.

Client-Initiated Backchannel Authentication: for a sensitive agent-initiated action the policy requests approval on the user's own device (bc-authorize, then poll) — triggered by the agent context, NOT by amount. A compromised browser or rogue agent cannot self-approve.
Above the ceiling the policy denies outright. DENY outranks every obligation — no receipt, no MFA, no approval can clear it.
Approvals are receipts, not vibes: single-use (consume-on-use, so a replay re-challenges), amount-bound (approving $300 cannot discharge $600), and the MFA credit expires after five minutes.

cards.label: Scenario 1: HITL: $300 needs human consent
cards.description: The amount clears the confirm bar but not the MFA bar: the agent pauses, a consent modal is surfaced, and only an explicit human approval (a single-use receipt) lets it proceed.

cards.label: Scenario 2: MFA: $600 steps up to device MFA
cards.description: The amount clears the MFA bar: step-up OUTRANKS the consent gate — the human must complete device MFA (demo OTP 123123), then the policy re-evaluates to PERMIT.

cards.label: Scenario 3: CIBA: $150, approved out-of-band on the phone
cards.description: Note the amount — below every band. A person in-browser would sail through. But an AGENT moving money is a sensitive agent-initiated action, so approval is requested out-of-band (bc-authorize, then poll) on the user's phone. Amount-independent by design.

cards.label: Scenario 4: DENY: $2500 exceeds the hard limit
cards.description: Above the ceiling the policy denies outright. DENY outranks every obligation — no receipt, no MFA, no approval can clear it.

cards.label: Scenario 5: REPLAY: the same approved receipt cannot be used twice
cards.description: An approved $300 consent receipt discharges the gate ONCE (consume-on-use). Retrying the same transfer after the credit is spent re-challenges — a stolen receipt cannot approve a second transfer.

cards.label: Scenario 6: BOUND: approving $300 does not authorize $600
cards.description: The receipt is amount-bound: a credit approved for $300 discharges only calls at or below $300. The $600 call ignores it and steps up to MFA.

cards.label: Reconfigure the policy live
cards.description: Change the amount bands live; the SAME call flips on the next run — a crossing edit falls back to the defaults, never wider.

cards.label: Doctor and health
cards.description: Preflight checks and the demo-health/1 endpoint.
